programme.title: ⋗ Inside the NBA
programme.desc: Inside the NBA (Sports). This Emmy Award-winning studio show, which airs following NBA telecasts on ESPN, is hosted by Ernie Johnson, with analysis from Hall of Famer Charles Barkley and NBA champions Kenny Smith and Shaquille O'Neal. It's a mix of highlights, interviews and hijinks, notably the verbal sparring sessions between the outspoken Barkley and his straight man, Smith. The show also welcomes various guest analysts throughout the season

programme.title: ⋗ SportsCenter With Scott Van Pelt
programme.desc: SportsCenter With Scott Van Pelt (Sports). SVP's up at midnight and bringing his unique perspective on games people play to «SportsCenter» viewers. The hourlong, late-night show is driven by the host's self-deprecating wit and passion for sports, with featured elements, including Van Pelt's nightly «1 Big Thing» commentary and a weekly look back at the moments that drove bettors wild in «Bad Beats.» The show also delivers what «SportsCenter» fans are used to – news and highlights, guests and interviews – but in a different, fast-paced and insightful way

programme.title: Cyclisme : Tour Auvergne-Rhône-Alpes
programme.desc: Anciennement Critérium du Dauphiné, le Tour Auvergne-Rhône-Alpes 2026 débute par une étape de montagne, entre Vizille et Saint-Ismier. Au menu notamment, le col de l'Arzelier.

programme.title: Motocross : Championnat du monde
programme.desc: Suivez des courses du Championnat du monde de motocross. Chaque année, les meilleurs pilotes du monde s'affrontent pour le titre décerné par la Fédération internationale de motocyclisme. De mars à octobre, ils concourent sur 20 circuits en Europe, en Asie, en Amérique du Sud et du Nord. Le championnat du monde se déroule dans les catégories de moteurs MXGP, MX2 et MX3.

programme.title: Motocross : Championnat du monde
programme.desc: Le Français Tom Vialle (Honda) est à la lutte pour le titre en MXGP cette saison. L'Avignonnais a pour principaux concurrents le Belge Lucas Coenen (KTM) et le Néerlandais Jeffrey Herlings (Honda). A suivre également deux autres Français, Romain Febvre (Kawasaki) et Maxime Renaux (Yamaha). Qui s'imposera en Lettonie, sur le circuit de Ķegums ?

programme.title: Handball : Ligue des champions féminine EHF
programme.desc: Retransmission des matchs de la Ligue des Champions féminine EHF, compétition de clubs de handball la plus importante en Europe. Organisée par la Fédération européenne de handball, la première saison de cette compétition a été jouée en 1961.

programme.title: Endurance : 24 Heures du Mans
programme.desc: 62 concurrents s'élancent à la conquête du trophée des 24 Heures du Mans 2025. Qui succédera au palmarès à l'équipage Ferrari Antonio Fuoco, Nicklas Nielsen et Miguel Molina ?

programme.title: Escalade : Coupe du monde
programme.desc: Retransmission de manches de la Coupe du monde d'escalade. Organisée par l'IFSC depuis 1989, cette compétition annuelle se déroule à travers plusieurs étapes partout dans le monde. Trois catégories composent cette discipline : escalade de vitesse, de bloc, et de difficulté. Chacune d'entre elles donne un vainqueur dans sa catégorie. Il existe également un titre combiné pour les athlètes engagés dans deux catégories différentes.

programme.title: Cyclisme : Tour Auvergne-Rhône-Alpes
programme.desc: Pour cette 2e étape entre Saint-Martin-le-Vinoux et Le Puy-en-Velay, le peloton traverse quatre départements ; l'Isère, la Drôme, l'Ardèche et la Haute-Loire. Les principales difficultés du parcours : le col Robert-Marchand (2e catégorie, km 128,7), la côte des Baraques (2e catégorie, km 206,3) et la côte de Saint-Vidal (3e catégorie, km 225,5).

programme.title: Escalade : Coupe du monde
programme.desc: La Coupe du monde de difficulté fait étape à Prague, pour la deuxième manche de la saison. L'Américaine Annie Sander et le Japonais Neo Suzuki se sont imposés en Chine, le 9 mai dernier, en ouverture de la saison. A suivre également la Slovène Janja Garnbret, l'Espagnol Alberto Ginés López et le Français Max Bertone.

programme.title: Moto : 8 Heures de Spa-Francorchamps
programme.desc: Qui va succéder à Honda au palmarès des 8 Heures de Spa Motos ? L'an dernier, la victoire était revenue aux Français Alan Techeret et Corentin Perolari, associés au Japonais Taiga Hada. La deuxième manche du championnat du monde d'Endurance FIM EWC s'annonce, cette année, comme l'un des moments forts de la saison.

programme.title: The Last Dance: Episode 10
programme.desc: The Last Dance (Sports). In the fall of 1997, Michael Jordan and the Chicago Bulls allowed a film crew to follow them as they went for their sixth NBA title in eight seasons. That resulted in a stunning portrait of one of the sport's most iconic athletes and a celebrated team. «The Last Dance» follows the Bulls' 1997-98 season from start to finish, while also covering the rest of the chapters in Jordan's remarkable career. The 10-part docuseries follows the Jordan timeline from when he was an emerging star on his high school team to becoming a worldwide marketing force and cultural figure. The series takes its name from a phrase coined by then-Bulls coach Phil Jackson, who knew that the season would likely be the final run for the core members of that 1990s Bulls dynasty

programme.title: 30 for 30: This Magic Moment
programme.desc: 30 for 30 (Sports). As part of its 30th anniversary celebration, ESPN looks back at notable sports happenings that occurred from 1979 to 2009 with this documentary series featuring 30 films from some of Hollywood's finest directors and producers. Peter Berg, Barry Levinson, John Singleton, Spike Jonze, Dan Klores, Barbara Kopple, Ron Shelton and Albert Maysles are among the filmmakers involved, and the stories told include the shocking trade of Wayne Gretzky in 1988, the Baltimore Colts' nighttime move in 1984, Reggie Miller's rivalry with the New York Knicks, the death of Len Bias in 1986, a profile of George Steinbrenner and his family business, and a look at Michael Jordan's attempt at a baseball career. A new series of 30 films premiered in October 2012 with «Broke,» about the challenges athletes face in managing their money

programme.desc: La Coupe du monde de difficulté fait étape à Prague, pour la deuxième manche de la saison. programme.title: Les Rois de la Pédale | L'avant-course
programme.desc: Retrouvez Louis-Pierre Frileux avec ses consultants qui débriefent et commentent toute l'actualité du cyclisme en plateau. Ils reviennent sur les dernières infos des équipes et les derniers résultats des courses. En bonus certains de ces champions de la pédale seront interviewés.

programme.title: Cyclisme : Tour Auvergne-Rhône-Alpes
programme.desc: Pour cette 2e étape entre Saint-Martin-le-Vinoux et Le Puy-en-Velay, le peloton traverse quatre départements ; l'Isère, la Drôme, l'Ardèche et la Haute-Loire. Les principales difficultés du parcours : le col Robert-Marchand (2e catégorie, km 128,7), la côte des Baraques (2e catégorie, km 206,3) et la côte de Saint-Vidal (3e catégorie, km 225,5).

programme.title: Sara Price Chasing Dakar

L'icône des sports automobiles embarque dans une quête épique pour devenir la première Américaine à remporter le Rallye Dakar.

programme.title: Moto : 8 Heures de Spa-Francorchamps
programme.desc: Qui va succéder à Honda au palmarès des 8 Heures de Spa Motos ? La deuxième manche du championnat du monde d'Endurance FIM EWC s'annonce, cette année, comme l'un des moments forts de la saison.

programme.title: Endurance : 6 Heures d'Imola
programme.desc: Direction l'Italie pour la 16e édition des 6 Heures d'Imola, deuxième manche de la saison du FIA WEC, disputées sur le mythique circuit Autodromo Enzo e Dino Ferrari. programme.title: Les Rois de la Pédale | L'avant-course
programme.desc: Retrouvez Louis-Pierre Frileux avec ses consultants qui débriefent et commentent toute l'actualité du cyclisme en plateau. Ils reviennent sur les dernières infos des équipes et les derniers résultats des courses. En bonus certains de ces champions de la pédale seront interviewés.

programme.title: Cyclisme : Tour Auvergne-Rhône-Alpes

programme.title: Italie | Les temps forts
programme.desc: A suivre le championnat du monde de Formule 1 motonautique. Aussi connu sous l'appellation de F1H2O, il s'agit d'une compétition internationale de bateaux à moteur organisée par l'Union Internationale Motonautique (UIM). Les courses durent environ 45 minutes et se déroulent sur des lacs ou des parcours d'eau fermés. La première édition de la F1H2O a eu lieu en 1981.

The flagship series airs an evening edition and a brand new late-night show each weekday before the stage is cleared for a live «SportsCenter» morning block that emphasizes fast-paced, highlights-driven reports and what's new on social media platforms

programme.title: ⋗ Inside the NBA
programme.desc: Inside the NBA (Sports). This Emmy Award-winning studio show, which airs following NBA telecasts on ESPN, is hosted by Ernie Johnson, with analysis from Hall of Famer Charles Barkley and NBA champions Kenny Smith and Shaquille O'Neal. It's a mix of highlights, interviews and hijinks, notably the verbal sparring sessions between the outspoken Barkley and his straight man, Smith. The show also welcomes various guest analysts throughout the season

programme.title: ⋗ SportsCenter With Scott Van Pelt
programme.desc: SportsCenter With Scott Van Pelt (Sports). SVP's up at midnight and bringing his unique perspective on games people play to «SportsCenter» viewers. The hourlong, late-night show is driven by the host's self-deprecating wit and passion for sports, with featured elements, including Van Pelt's nightly «1 Big Thing» commentary and a weekly look back at the moments that drove bettors wild in «Bad Beats.» The show also delivers what «SportsCenter» fans are used to – news and highlights, guests and interviews – but in a different, fast-paced and insightful way

programme.title: ⋗ SportsCenter
programme.desc: SportsCenter (Sports). The latest news, highlights and inside information from every corner of the sports world is presented each day on «SportsCenter,» ESPN's first-ever program when the network debuted in September of 1979. The flagship series airs an evening edition and a brand new late-night show each weekday before the stage is cleared for a live «SportsCenter» morning block that emphasizes fast-paced, highlights-driven reports and what's new on social media platforms

programme.title: ⋗ Inside the NBA
programme.desc: Inside the NBA (Sports). This Emmy Award-winning studio show, which airs following NBA telecasts on ESPN, is hosted by Ernie Johnson, with analysis from Hall of Famer Charles Barkley and NBA champions Kenny Smith and Shaquille O'Neal. It's a mix of highlights, interviews and hijinks, notably the verbal sparring sessions between the outspoken Barkley and his straight man, Smith. The show also welcomes various guest analysts throughout the season

It's a mix of highlights, interviews and hijinks, notably the verbal sparring sessions between the outspoken Barkley and his straight man, Smith. The show also welcomes various guest analysts throughout the season

programme.title: ⋗ SportsCenter With Scott Van Pelt
programme.desc: SportsCenter With Scott Van Pelt (Sports). SVP's up at midnight and bringing his unique perspective on games people play to «SportsCenter» viewers. The hourlong, late-night show is driven by the host's self-deprecating wit and passion for sports, with featured elements, including Van Pelt's nightly «1 Big Thing» commentary and a weekly look back at the moments that drove bettors wild in «Bad Beats.» The show also delivers what «SportsCenter» fans are used to – news and highlights, guests and interviews – but in a different, fast-paced and insightful way

programme.title: ⋗ SportsCenter
programme.desc: SportsCenter (Sports). The latest news, highlights and inside information from every corner of the sports world is presented each day on «SportsCenter,» ESPN's first-ever program when the network debuted in September of 1979. The flagship series airs an evening edition and a brand new late-night show each weekday before the stage is cleared for a live «SportsCenter» morning block that emphasizes fast-paced, highlights-driven reports and what's new on social media platforms

programme.title: ⋗ Inside the NBA
programme.desc: Inside the NBA (Sports). This Emmy Award-winning studio show, which airs following NBA telecasts on ESPN, is hosted by Ernie Johnson, with analysis from Hall of Famer Charles Barkley and NBA champions Kenny Smith and Shaquille O'Neal. It's a mix of highlights, interviews and hijinks, notably the verbal sparring sessions between the outspoken Barkley and his straight man, Smith. The show also welcomes various guest analysts throughout the season

programme.title: Tirreno
programme.desc: Vive lo más emocionante de la carrera ciclista Tirreno-Adriático en su edición 2026. La competición cruza cinco regiones italianas con un recorrido variado que ofrecerá oportunidades para todo tipo de corredores. El recorrido está repleto de desafíos, como el sector de tierra que cierra la etapa de San Gimignano y las numerosas subidas cortas y empinadas de las etapas de Marcas.

programme.title: Liege Bastogne
programme.desc: Vive las emociones de esta competencia de ciclismo profesional situada en Banneux, en la magnífica región de Valonia, que te lleva a través de impresionantes paisajes entre naturaleza, bosque y montaña.

programme.title: Power Slap
programme.desc: Power Slap es la organización de lucha contra bofetadas más importante del mundo, autorizada y sancionada por la Comisión Atlética del Estado de Nevada.

programme.title: Giro de Italia Women
programme.desc: Vive lo mejor de las jornadas de competencia en el marco del Giro de Italia Femenino 2026. La carrera recorre el país de norte a sur y de este a oeste y expone no solo incones recónditos y lugares apartados sino también los lugares más emblemáticos del ciclismo italiano.

programme.title: Liege Bastogne
programme.desc: Vive las emociones de esta competencia de ciclismo profesional situada en Banneux, en la magnífica región de Valonia, que te lleva a través de impresionantes paisajes entre naturaleza, bosque y montaña.

programme.title: FIBA BCLA
programme.desc: Vive lo más emocionante de la temporada 2026 de la Liga de Campeones de Baloncesto de las Américas. El público podrá disfrutar de los partidos del torneo continental de FIBA para la región Américas, que recibea 12 equipos de siete países de la región. En primera instancia los equipos se dividen en cuatro grupos de tres equipos cada uno, donde se enfrentan todos contra todos dos veces, en la cancha de cada equipo. Los dos mejores equipos acceden a la siguiente ronda que consta de play-offs al mejor de tres partidos hasta la final.

programme.title: LGCT
programme.desc: Vive lo más emocionante de las competencias en la Gira de Campeones Mundiales de Longines 2026. El público disfrutará de uno de los circuitos más prestigiosos del salto internacional, combinando excelencia deportiva, escenarios icónicos y gran espectáculo.

programme.title: EuroLeague
programme.desc: Vive los partidos de la 26º edición de la EuroLiga de básquet, la máxima competición de clubes de Europa.

programme.title: Hilos

programme.title: The Last Dance: Episode 10
programme.desc: The Last Dance (Sports). In the fall of 1997, Michael Jordan and the Chicago Bulls allowed a film crew to follow them as they went for their sixth NBA title in eight seasons. That resulted in a stunning portrait of one of the sport's most iconic athletes and a celebrated team. «The Last Dance» follows the Bulls' 1997-98 season from start to finish, while also covering the rest of the chapters in Jordan's remarkable career. The 10-part docuseries follows the Jordan timeline from when he was an emerging star on his high school team to becoming a worldwide marketing force and cultural figure. The series takes its name from a phrase coined by then-Bulls coach Phil Jackson, who knew that the season would likely be the final run for the core members of that 1990s Bulls dynasty

programme.title: 30 for 30: This Magic Moment
programme.desc: 30 for 30 (Sports). As part of its 30th anniversary celebration, ESPN looks back at notable sports happenings that occurred from 1979 to 2009 with this documentary series featuring 30 films from some of Hollywood's finest directors and producers. Peter Berg, Barry Levinson, John Singleton, Spike Jonze, Dan Klores, Barbara Kopple, Ron Shelton and Albert Maysles are among the filmmakers involved, and the stories told include the shocking trade of Wayne Gretzky in 1988, the Baltimore Colts' nighttime move in 1984, Reggie Miller's rivalry with the New York Knicks, the death of Len Bias in 1986, a profile of George Steinbrenner and his family business, and a look at Michael Jordan's attempt at a baseball career. A new series of 30 films premiered in October 2012 with «Broke,» about the challenges athletes face in managing their money

programme.desc: SportsCenter (Sports). The latest news, highlights and inside information from every corner of the sports world is presented each day on «SportsCenter,» ESPN's first-ever program when the network debuted in September of 1979. The flagship series airs an evening edition and a brand new late-night show each weekday before the stage is cleared for a live «SportsCenter» morning block that emphasizes fast-paced, highlights-driven reports and what's new on social media platforms

programme.title: ⋗ Inside the NBA
programme.desc: Inside the NBA (Sports). This Emmy Award-winning studio show, which airs following NBA telecasts on ESPN, is hosted by Ernie Johnson, with analysis from Hall of Famer Charles Barkley and NBA champions Kenny Smith and Shaquille O'Neal. It's a mix of highlights, interviews and hijinks, notably the verbal sparring sessions between the outspoken Barkley and his straight man, Smith. The show also welcomes various guest analysts throughout the season

This Emmy Award-winning studio show, which airs following NBA telecasts on ESPN, is hosted by Ernie Johnson, with analysis from Hall of Famer Charles Barkley and NBA champions Kenny Smith and Shaquille O'Neal. It's a mix of highlights, interviews and hijinks, notably the verbal sparring sessions between the outspoken Barkley and his straight man, Smith. The show also welcomes various guest analysts throughout the season

programme.title: ⋗ SportsCenter With Scott Van Pelt
programme.desc: SportsCenter With Scott Van Pelt (Sports). SVP's up at midnight and bringing his unique perspective on games people play to «SportsCenter» viewers. The hourlong, late-night show is driven by the host's self-deprecating wit and passion for sports, with featured elements, including Van Pelt's nightly «1 Big Thing» commentary and a weekly look back at the moments that drove bettors wild in «Bad Beats.» The show also delivers what «SportsCenter» fans are used to – news and highlights, guests and interviews – but in a different, fast-paced and insightful way

programme.title: ⋗ SportsCenter
programme.desc: SportsCenter (Sports). The latest news, highlights and inside information from every corner of the sports world is presented each day on «SportsCenter,» ESPN's first-ever program when the network debuted in September of 1979. The flagship series airs an evening edition and a brand new late-night show each weekday before the stage is cleared for a live «SportsCenter» morning block that emphasizes fast-paced, highlights-driven reports and what's new on social media platforms

programme.title: ⋗ Inside the NBA
programme.desc: Inside the NBA (Sports). This Emmy Award-winning studio show, which airs following NBA telecasts on ESPN, is hosted by Ernie Johnson, with analysis from Hall of Famer Charles Barkley and NBA champions Kenny Smith and Shaquille O'Neal. It's a mix of highlights, interviews and hijinks, notably the verbal sparring sessions between the outspoken Barkley and his straight man, Smith. The show also welcomes various guest analysts throughout the season

programme.title: ⋗ SportsCenter With Scott Van Pelt
programme.desc: SportsCenter With Scott Van Pelt (Sports). SVP's up at midnight and bringing his unique perspective on games people play to «SportsCenter» viewers. The hourlong, late-night show is driven by the host's self-deprecating wit and passion for sports, with featured elements, including Van Pelt's nightly «1 Big Thing» commentary and a weekly look back at the moments that drove bettors wild in «Bad Beats.» The show also delivers what «SportsCenter» fans are used to – news and highlights, guests and interviews – but in a different, fast-paced and insightful way

programme.title: ⋗ SportsCenter
programme.desc: SportsCenter (Sports). The latest news, highlights and inside information from every corner of the sports world is presented each day on «SportsCenter,» ESPN's first-ever program when the network debuted in September of 1979. The flagship series airs an evening edition and a brand new late-night show each weekday before the stage is cleared for a live «SportsCenter» morning block that emphasizes fast-paced, highlights-driven reports and what's new on social media platforms

programme.title: ⋗ Inside the NBA
programme.desc: Inside the NBA (Sports). This Emmy Award-winning studio show, which airs following NBA telecasts on ESPN, is hosted by Ernie Johnson, with analysis from Hall of Famer Charles Barkley and NBA champions Kenny Smith and Shaquille O'Neal. It's a mix of highlights, interviews and hijinks, notably the verbal sparring sessions between the outspoken Barkley and his straight man, Smith. The show also welcomes various guest analysts throughout the season

programme.title: ⋗ SportsCenter With Scott Van Pelt
programme.desc: SportsCenter With Scott Van Pelt (Sports). SVP's up at midnight and bringing his unique perspective on games people play to «SportsCenter» viewers. The hourlong, late-night show is driven by the host's self-deprecating wit and passion for sports, with featured elements, including Van Pelt's nightly «1 Big Thing» commentary and a weekly look back at the moments that drove bettors wild in «Bad Beats.» The show also delivers what «SportsCenter» fans are used to – news and highlights, guests and interviews – but in a different, fast-paced and insightful way

La selección española, dirigida por José Antonio Camacho, se había clasificado, de forma brillante, para los octavos de final como primero de su grupo tras ganar los 3 partidos. Venía de sufrir, mucho más de lo esperado, ante Irlanda, a la que sólo pudo ganar desde el punto de penalti

programme.desc: Inside the NBA (Sports). This Emmy Award-winning studio show, which airs following NBA telecasts on ESPN, is hosted by Ernie Johnson, with analysis from Hall of Famer Charles Barkley and NBA champions Kenny Smith and Shaquille O'Neal. It's a mix of highlights, interviews and hijinks, notably the verbal sparring sessions between the outspoken Barkley and his straight man, Smith. The show also welcomes various guest analysts throughout the season

programme.title: ⋗ SportsCenter With Scott Van Pelt
programme.desc: SportsCenter With Scott Van Pelt (Sports). SVP's up at midnight and bringing his unique perspective on games people play to «SportsCenter» viewers. The hourlong, late-night show is driven by the host's self-deprecating wit and passion for sports, with featured elements, including Van Pelt's nightly «1 Big Thing» commentary and a weekly look back at the moments that drove bettors wild in «Bad Beats.» The show also delivers what «SportsCenter» fans are used to – news and highlights, guests and interviews – but in a different, fast-paced and insightful way

programme.title: ⋗ Inside the NBA
programme.desc: Inside the NBA (Sports). This Emmy Award-winning studio show, which airs following NBA telecasts on ESPN, is hosted by Ernie Johnson, with analysis from Hall of Famer Charles Barkley and NBA champions Kenny Smith and Shaquille O'Neal. It's a mix of highlights, interviews and hijinks, notably the verbal sparring sessions between the outspoken Barkley and his straight man, Smith. The show also welcomes various guest analysts throughout the season

programme.title: ⋗ SportsCenter With Scott Van Pelt
programme.desc: SportsCenter With Scott Van Pelt (Sports). SVP's up at midnight and bringing his unique perspective on games people play to «SportsCenter» viewers. The hourlong, late-night show is driven by the host's self-deprecating wit and passion for sports, with featured elements, including Van Pelt's nightly «1 Big Thing» commentary and a weekly look back at the moments that drove bettors wild in «Bad Beats.» The show also delivers what «SportsCenter» fans are used to – news and highlights, guests and interviews – but in a different, fast-paced and insightful way
